  - [1m/model:[0m [1mSave as default[0m, which is not the recommended option. Picking a model from the chat will work like pressing
    Enter in the terminal: it becomes the default for new sessions and gets written to [38;5;153m~/.claude/settings.json[39m or
    [38;5;153m~/.codex/config.toml[39m. The chat's confirmation should say that it saves a default.
